# Third-party data, services and libraries

Arcadia bundles or uses the following. The same credits appear in the app under Settings → Travel maps & place search,
and the map shows the attribution for whatever it is drawing.

## Bundled data (in `Arcadia.Infrastructure`, generated by `tools/Arcadia.GeoForge`)

| Data | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| Country outlines (1:110m and 1:50m admin-0), label points, continents | Natural Earth — https://www.naturalearthdata.com | Public domain |
| Cities with population ≥ 15,000 (`cities15000`), alternate Arabic names | GeoNames — https://www.geonames.org | CC BY 4.0 — © GeoNames |
| Country flags (SVG → 48 px PNG) | hampusborgos/country-flags — https://github.com/hampusborgos/country-flags | Public domain |

## Online services (optional, off with one switch each in Settings)

| Service | Used for | Terms |
|---|---|---|
| OpenStreetMap standard tiles (`tile.openstreetmap.org`) | Detail map when zoomed in | Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; tile usage policy https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/ |
| Nominatim (`nominatim.openstreetmap.org`) | Place search / reverse lookup, only when the user asks | Usage policy https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/ (≤ 1 request/s, identifying User-Agent, results cached) |
| IGDB (Twitch) and SteamGridDB | Game details and artwork (Phase 4, user's own keys) | Their respective API terms |

A custom XYZ tile server can be configured instead of OpenStreetMap; its attribution text is entered with it and shown on the map.

| Package | Licence |
|---|---|
| MetadataExtractor (EXIF/GPS from photos) | Apache 2.0 |
| Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite, Microsoft.Data.Sqlite, SQLitePCLRaw | MIT / Apache 2.0 (SQLite: public domain) |
| Microsoft.Extensions.* (Hosting, DI, Logging, Http) | MIT |
| System.Management, System.Diagnostics.EventLog/PerformanceCounter, System.ServiceProcess.ServiceController, System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData | MIT |
| CommunityToolkit.Mvvm | MIT |
| .NET runtime and WPF (bundled by the self-contained installer) | MIT |
| Svg (build-time only, GeoForge flag rendering) | Microsoft Public License |
